reviewers.agent: general-purpose subagent (Claude Fable 5), findings-only context, shell probes + live gh api checks

records.finding: gate executed the PR's own copy of .warden/bin/warden with the deploy key already on disk — vacuous pass and key exfiltration possible from a same-repo PR
records.evidence: checkout of PR merge ref; key written before shim ran; protected_paths enforced by the replaceable binary itself
records.reason: gate now restores .warden/bin, .warden/rules, .warden/skills-policy.md, repo.yaml, graph.yaml from origin/BASE_REF before the key is written or any gate code runs; policy changes take effect only after merge (the safe direction); .warden/memory deliberately not restored so attest check still sees the PR's shard

records.finding: empty module list exited 0 — a green no-op for every mode
records.evidence: probed: for-loop over failing substitution survives set -e with fail=0
records.reason: module counter added; zero modules exits 2 (infra), probe-verified in a scratch repo

records.finding: step named all-modules linted only the root module
records.evidence: golangci-lint-action runs in a single working directory
records.reason: replaced with pinned go install of golangci-lint v2.13.1 + ci-go.sh lint mode looping every module

records.finding: fork exemption on the attest step was unreachable — earlier steps fail closed without the deploy key
records.evidence: review/verify precede the guard; shim exits 2 without credentials
records.reason: fork handling removed entirely with an honest header comment: private repo, same-repo branches only; fork-PR gate handling recorded on the go-public checklist bead (workspace-tmw.10.3)

records.finding: govulncheck @latest, golangci latest, actions pinned by mutable tags
records.evidence: repo's own shim rationale: a tag can be force-moved, a SHA cannot
records.reason: all third-party actions pinned to commit SHAs (checkout/setup-uv/upload from the adoption guide, setup-go and gitleaks resolved via gh api), govulncheck pinned v1.7.0, golangci-lint pinned v2.13.1

records.finding: github expressions interpolated directly into run: shell text
records.evidence: head.repo.full_name and base_ref in run blocks
records.reason: base_ref routed through job-level env BASE_REF and referenced as a shell variable; the fork-check interpolation no longer exists

records.finding: comment claimed required check on every PR; branch is unprotected
records.reason: comment rewritten to state the truth: required-ness lives in branch protection outside this file, and until it exists the delegated-merge green-only discipline is the control; protection attempt follows post-merge and its outcome is reported on the bead

records.finding: gofmt parse errors passed the fmt check (pipeline exit was grep's)
records.reason: fmt mode captures gofmt exit status and stderr; error output fails the check

records.finding: unquoted for-loop word-split module paths; *go.mod matched djangogo.mod
records.evidence: probed in a scratch repo with a spaced dir and djangogo.mod
records.reason: IFS=newline + set -f; pathspecs go.mod and */go.mod anchor the basename

records.finding: repo.yaml verify.core (root-only) and ci-go.sh (all modules) were two disagreeing sources of truth
records.evidence: root ./... prunes at nested go.mod boundaries
records.reason: repo.yaml verify.core now calls ./scripts/ci-go.sh fmt/vet/build/test — one module-complete definition for both the attested verify and the CI core job
